• The community is very genuine and welcoming, with many people finding great friendships and fellowship here.

• Altar servers wear traditional cassocks and surplices, which is appreciated by some visitors.

communityInsights:
• The church is a beautiful example of French Neo-Gothic architecture, located tranquilly near Lake Prior.
• It's open during the day for quiet prayer, offering an easily accessed holy place.

• The church offers a welcoming atmosphere and a strong sense of belonging, with many appreciating the good people who attend.
• Visitors have noted the new priest is very engaged, bringing energy and passion to his calling.
• The church building is described as beautiful and accommodating, with a meaningful service.

• The chapel is described as an architectural work of art, beautiful, quiet, and serene, offering a great place for reflection.
• The campus grounds are beautiful and considered worth a trip to visit.
• Visitors have experienced wonderful hospitality and felt treated like royalty.
• The community is known for its beautiful people and deep faith.
• The Sisters are noted for being very nice and helpful.

• The church is beautiful and has a great layout, accommodating many people attending Mass.
• The priest is personable and makes attendees feel good, with some noting excellent staff and clergy.
• The community is welcoming and friendly, creating an open atmosphere that is attentive to young children.
